title: herding.agents registry + named resolution in resolve_agent_command and bee herding run --agent
action: Per D1/D2: (a) wave.rs reads herding.agents (map name -> argv token array; per-entry validation identical to agent_command_tokens: non-empty array of newline-free strings, malformed ENTRY ignored fail-open). (b) resolve_agent_command gains an optional agent-name parameter: Some(name) resolves through the registry — unknown name returns a typed error whose message LISTS the registry's key names; None keeps today's behavior, EXCEPT herding.agent_command being a plain JSON STRING now resolves that string through the registry the same way. (c) run.rs gains --agent <name>, threading the name to resolve_agent_command for the spawn; --continue ignores --agent (the pane already exists). Registry payload: document the new flag on herding.run; examples[0] stays byte-identical and green. Tests: named lookup returns the registry argv; unknown name error text contains every registry key; string-valued agent_command aliases through the registry; absent agent keeps the default; wave callers unchanged (pass None).
